why: Instrument defect found while building, on the planted fixture, before any measured run (prereg b4e653f3). Two defects of the planted-run helper. (1) The fixture package had no Go machine, so the composed route refused at DISCH ('no documents') before derive and the run produced no law: every planted check could hold under no implementation. tests_m6/fixtures/i125's gate package gains Counter, a Go machine written from the Go specification alone (a uint64 field and a guarded increment, the same construct I117's fixture uses), only so that DISCH has a document; Low, Quot and Twice are unchanged. (2) The opt-in run used spec/M6/lib/i125_run.json whole, whose iteration tag ('I125' against 'base') the composed route writes into each Go machine document, so every law over that document moved its facts_sha256 for a reason that is not the opt-in: P3 compared two changes, not one. The opt-in run now uses the base protocol plus exactly run_unbound_reason and run_unbound_reason_doc, taken from i125_run.json (Q104 (2): one change per measurement). No claim, threshold or prediction changes.

Instrument defect found while building, on the planted fixture, before any measured run (prereg b4e653f3). With the fixture's Go machine (the line on run), the run generates two Go-op models (blob_ops for Blob's ops, counter_ops for Counter's Bump), and the check picked the one model whose file name holds '_ops', so it raised ValueError. It now picks the model that defines gate_Low. The assertions are unchanged.

Instrument defect found while building, on the planted fixture, before any measured run (prereg b4e653f3). The same model selection as test_p1 (by the definition of gate_Low, not the file name). And the check expected each law's op_refused attempt to list only the op it was iterating over, but PAR's pair laws (dom and weak) name two ops; L_par_*_gate_Quot_gate_Twice names both refused ops, and the attempt (rightly) lists both. The expected ops are now every refused op the law is over, in sorted order, each with its class and goops' reason, and each law is checked once. Every other assertion (UNKNOWN, one attempt of kind op_refused, the binding error kept, the reason in the bound, no witness, no law or proof file, the same laws UNKNOWN by binding without the opt-in, the count) is unchanged.
